{{Elections in New Hampshire}}
The '''2026 New Hampshire gubernatorial election''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[Governor of New Hampshire|governor]] of the [[U.S. state]] of [[New Hampshire]]. The primary elections will take place on September 8, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025 |title=2026 State Primary Election Dates |url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|website= NCSL |access-date=5 August 2025}}</ref> Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] governor [[Kelly Ayotte]] is running for re-election to a second two-year term in office. 

Along with neighboring [[2026 Vermont gubernatorial election|Vermont]], this will be one of two Republican-held governorships up for election in a state that [[Kamala Harris]] won in the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 presidential election]].

== Background ==
New Hampshire has voted [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] in each presidential race starting in [[2004 United States presidential election in New Hampshire|2004]]. The state's congressional delegation has been entirely Democratic since 2017. Conversely, Republicans hold a trifecta on the statewide level, with a supermajority in the [[New Hampshire Senate]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Cullen |first=Margie |date=November 7, 2024 |title=NH keeps GOP in control of state while voting for Democrats in D.C. Experts explain why. |url=https://www.seacoastonline.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/11/07/nh-voters-republicans-state-government-democrats-washington/76085089007/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241107101231/https://eu.seacoastonline.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/11/07/nh-voters-republicans-state-government-democrats-washington/76085089007/ |archive-date=November 7, 2024 |access-date=January 17, 2026 |work=[[Portsmouth Herald]]}}</ref>

In [[2024 New Hampshire gubernatorial election|2024]], [[Kelly Ayotte]] won the gubernatorial election by 9.34%.<ref>{{Cite web |date=January 23, 2025 |title=New Hampshire Governor |url=https://www.cookpolitical.com/governor/race/479551 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20260118013611/https://www.cookpolitical.com/governor/race/479551 |archive-date=January 18, 2026 |access-date=January 17, 2026 |website=[[Cook Political Report]]}}</ref>
